title: AFSCA 3rd National Flying Saucer Convention flyer, Reno, July 1966, with saucer photos
description: Promotional flyer for "AFSCA's (Amalgamated Flying Saucer Clubs of America) 3rd National FLYING SAUCER CONVENTION" at the Centennial Coliseum, "Reno, Nevada - July 8,9,10, 1966," listing speakers and offering "Saucer movies, slides, exhibits, books, literature." Two photographs show disc-shaped objects in the sky above trees. Text promises the "biggest collection of Flying Saucer photos on display" and the lower section is an advance registration form addressed to AFSCA Headquarters in Los Angeles.
